mapper.sql: FROM position p JOIN company_users cu ON cu.id = p.company_id WHERE p.status = 'active' AND cu.status = 1 AND cu.audit_status = 1 AND (p.position_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR cu.company_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) AND (p.city LIKE CONCAT('%', #{city}, '%') OR p.province LIKE CONCAT('%', #{city}, '%'))
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(p.id AS CHAR) AS id, p.position_name AS title, cu.company_name AS company, p.province, p.city, p.district, p.detail_address AS detailAddress, p.salary_min AS salaryMin, p.salary_max AS salaryMax, p.salary_unit AS salaryUnit, p.required_majors AS requiredMajors, p.status ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*)

choose.when: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM class_counselor_relation r WHERE r.class_id = su.class_id AND r.counselor_id = #{actor.id})

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS responsible, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ir.id IS NOT NULL AND ir.submit_time IS NOT NULL AND ir.status >= 0 AND NOT (ir.status = 0 AND COALESCE(ir.remark,'') = '0') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS submitted

SELECT CAST(su.id AS CHAR) AS id, su.name AS title, c.name AS className, CAST(ir.id AS CHAR) AS reflectionId, ir.period_number AS periodNumber, ir.deadline AS deadline, ir.submit_time AS submittedAt, CASE WHEN ir.id IS NOT NULL AND ir.submit_time IS NOT NULL AND ir.status >= 0 AND NOT (ir.status = 0 AND COALESCE(ir.remark,'') = '0') THEN 'SUBMITTED' ELSE 'NOT_SUBMITTED' END AS status
AND ir.id IS NOT NULL AND ir.submit_time IS NOT NULL AND ir.status >= 0 AND NOT (ir.status = 0 AND COALESCE(ir.remark,'') = '0') AND (ir.id IS NULL OR ir.submit_time IS NULL OR ir.status IS NULL OR ir.status < 0 OR (ir.status = 0 AND ir.remark = '0')) ORDER BY su.id LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT su.id FROM student_users su LEFT JOIN major m ON m.id = su.major_id WHERE su.status = 1 ORDER BY su.id

choose.when: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM class_counselor_relation summary_ccr WHERE summary_ccr.class_id = su.class_id AND summary_ccr.counselor_id = #{actor.id})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM class_counselor_relation summary_ccr WHERE summary_ccr.class_id = c.id AND summary_ccr.counselor_id = #{actor.id})
SELECT CAST(d.id AS CHAR) AS id, d.name FROM department d WHERE d.id = #{actor.departmentId} AND 1 = 0 AND d.id = #{scopeId} AND d.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{scopeName}, '%') ORDER BY d.id

SELECT CAST(c.id AS CHAR) AS id, c.name FROM class c LEFT JOIN major m ON m.id = c.major_id LEFT JOIN division dv ON dv.id = m.division_id WHERE 1 = 1
AND c.id = #{scopeId} AND c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{scopeName}, '%') ORDER BY c.id
choose.otherwise: SELECT NULL AS id, NULL AS name WHERE 1 = 0

mapper.select:
SELECT CAST(su.id AS CHAR) AS id, su.name AS title, su.student_user_id AS studentNo, c.name AS className, m.name AS major, dv.name AS division, sis.status AS internshipStatus, sis.company_name AS company, sis.position_name AS position FROM student_users su LEFT JOIN major m ON m.id = su.major_id LEFT JOIN division dv ON dv.id = m.division_id LEFT JOIN class c ON c.id = su.class_id LEFT JOIN student_internship_status sis ON sis.id = ( SELECT latest_status.id FROM student_internship_status latest_status WHERE latest_status.student_id = su.id ORDER BY latest_status.create_time DESC, latest_status.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE su.status = 1
AND dv.id = #{scopeId} AND c.id = #{scopeId} ORDER BY su.id
SELECT COUNT(*)

SELECT CAST(p.id AS CHAR) AS id, p.position_name AS title, p.status, p.remaining_quota AS remainingQuota, p.planned_recruit AS plannedRecruit, p.recruited_count AS recruitedCount, p.province, p.city, p.district, p.detail_address AS detailAddress, p.salary_min AS salaryMin, p.salary_max AS salaryMax, p.salary_unit AS salaryUnit, p.publish_date AS publishDate, p.view_count AS viewCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_job_application a WHERE a.position_id = p.id) AS applicationCount
ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*)

SELECT CAST(a.id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(a.position_id AS CHAR) AS positionId, a.position_name AS title, a.student_name AS studentName, a.student_no AS studentNo, a.major, a.grade, a.status, a.apply_date AS applyDate, a.source_type AS sourceType
ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT CAST(r.id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(r.student_id AS CHAR) AS studentId, r.student_name AS studentName, r.major, r.grade, r.class_name AS className, r.position_name AS title, r.internship_start_time AS startTime, r.internship_end_time AS endTime, r.status, r.create_time AS submittedAt FROM internship_confirmation_record r WHERE r.company_id = #{companyId} AND r.status = 0 AND COALESCE(r.recall_status, 0) = 0 ORDER BY r.id LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM internship_confirmation_record r WHERE r.company_id = #{companyId} AND r.status = 0 AND COALESCE(r.recall_status, 0) = 0

SELECT CAST(cu.id AS CHAR) AS id, cu.company_name AS title, cu.industry, cu.scale, cu.province, cu.city, cu.register_time AS registerTime, cu.apply_time AS applyTime, cu.audit_status AS auditStatus FROM company_users cu WHERE cu.audit_status = 0 ORDER BY cu.id LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM company_users cu WHERE cu.audit_status = 0

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_users WHERE status = 1) AS students, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM teacher_users WHERE status = 1) AS teachers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM company_users WHERE status = 1 AND audit_status = 1) AS approvedCompanies, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM company_users WHERE audit_status = 0) AS pendingCompanies, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM position) AS positions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM position WHERE status = 'active') AS activePositions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_job_application) AS jobApplications, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM internship_confirmation_record WHERE status = 0 AND COALESCE(recall_status, 0) = 0) AS pendingConfirmations
SELECT student_id FROM internship_reflection WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT student_id FROM internship_appraisal_submission WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT company_id FROM position WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT company_id FROM student_job_application WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT su.name AS title, su.student_user_id AS studentNumber, su.grade, c.name AS className, m.name AS major, d.name AS college, dv.name AS division, CASE WHEN COALESCE(su.phone,'') != '' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS phoneConfigured, CASE WHEN COALESCE(su.email,'') != '' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS emailConfigured FROM student_users su LEFT JOIN `class` c ON c.id = su.class_id LEFT JOIN major m ON m.id = su.major_id LEFT JOIN division dv ON dv.id = m.division_id LEFT JOIN department d ON d.id = COALESCE(m.department_id,dv.department_id) WHERE su.id = #{studentId}

SELECT CAST(ir.id AS CHAR) AS id, ir.period_number AS periodNumber, ir.deadline, ir.submit_time AS submittedAt, ir.status, CASE WHEN ir.submit_time IS NOT NULL AND ir.status >= 0 AND NOT (ir.status = 0 AND COALESCE(ir.remark,'') = '0') THEN 'SUBMITTED' ELSE 'NOT_SUBMITTED' END AS submissionStatus FROM internship_reflection ir WHERE ir.student_id = #{studentId} AND ir.deleted = 0 ORDER BY ir.period_number DESC, ir.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM internship_reflection WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND deleted = 0

SELECT CAST(s.id AS CHAR) AS id, s.status, s.submitted_at AS submittedAt, s.reviewed_at AS reviewedAt, s.review_comment AS reviewComment, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM internship_appraisal_file f WHERE f.submission_id = s.id) AS fileCount FROM internship_appraisal_submission s WHERE s.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY s.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS responsible, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ap.status = 'SUBMITTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS appraisalSubmitted, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ap.id IS NULL OR ap.status != 'SUBMITTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS appraisalNotSubmitted, COALESCE(SUM((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_application sa WHERE sa.student_id = su.id AND sa.application_type = 'selfPractice' AND sa.status = 'pending')),0) AS selfPracticePending, COALESCE(SUM((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_application sa WHERE sa.student_id = su.id AND sa.application_type = 'delay' AND sa.status = 'pending')),0) AS delayPending, COALESCE(SUM((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM internship_reflection ir WHERE ir.student_id = su.id AND ir.deleted = 0 AND ir.status = 0 AND ir.submit_time IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(ir.remark,'') != '0')),0) AS pendingReflection FROM student_users su LEFT JOIN major m ON m.id = su.major_id LEFT JOIN internship_appraisal_submission ap ON ap.id = (SELECT MAX(latest.id) FROM internship_appraisal_submission latest WHERE latest.student_id = su.id) WHERE su.status = 1
